Regulation: B.C. Reg. 118/2026
Made under: Income Tax Act
Published in: No. 13 – B.C. Regs. 110 to 124, July 14, 2026
Deposit date: July 10, 2026

B.C. Reg. 118/2026, deposited July 10, 2026, under theINCOME TAX ACT[section 213 (1) and (4)]. Order in Council 301/2026, approved and ordered July 10, 2026. On the recommendation of the undersigned, the Lieutenant Governor, by and with the advice and consent of the Executive Council, orders that, effective June 1, 2025, the Natural Gas Tax Credit Regulation, B.C. Reg. 145/2019, is amended as set out in the attached Schedule. — B. BAILEY,Minister of Finance; J. WICKENS,Presiding Member of the Executive Council. 1	The Natural Gas Tax Credit Regulation, B.C. Reg. 145/2019, is amended by adding the following section: Designated feedstock pipeline inlets – LNG Canada facility 1.3In respect of the major LNG facility known as LNG Canada and identified as BCLN3165257, the following meter stations are designated as feedstock pipeline inlets: (a)	the Wilde Lake Compressor Station; (b)	the Willow Valley Interconnect. 2	Section 2.1 (1) is amended in the description of "adjusted LNG facility inlet volume" by striking out "deemed to have been purchased under section 178 of the Act by the corporation in    the month at" and substituting "notionally acquired in the month by the corporation at". 3	Section 2.1 (2) is amended in the description of "LNG facility inlet volume" (a)	by adding "in the month" after "acquired", and (b)	by striking out "in the month" after "LNG facility". minutes_briefs.title: BC updates Natural Gas Tax Credit rules for LNG Canada feedstock
minutes_briefs.summary: British Columbia has amended its Natural Gas Tax Credit Regulation to update how LNG Canada calculates its tax credit. The change designates two specific pipeline meter stations (Wilde Lake Compressor Station and Willow Valley Interconnect) as official feedstock pipeline inlets for the LNG Canada facility. It also clarifies the wording around how natural gas volumes are counted for the credit. The amendment is retroactive to June 1, 2025.
minutes_briefs.action_required: If you operate or supply gas to LNG Canada, review your tax credit calculations to ensure they align with the updated inlet designations and wording.

key_dates.label: Natural Gas Tax Credit Regulation amendment takes effect (retroactive to June 1, 2025)
